sn11.2:1.4: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || 3.
sn11.2:2.2: atha kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Susīmaṃ devaputtaṃ āmantesi ||
sn11.2:2.3: ete tāta Susīma asurā deve abhiyanti ||
sn11.2:2.5: Evam bhadanta vā ti kho bhikkhave Susīmo devaputto Sakassa devānam indassa paṭissutvā pamādam āpādesi || || 5.
sn11.2:2.6: Dutiyam pi kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Susīmam devaputtam āmantesi || pa ||
sn11.2:2.8: Tatiyam pi kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Susīmam devaputtam āmantesi || pa ||
sn11.2:2.10: Atha kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Susīmaṃ devaputtaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn11.2:4.4: tam me Sakka varam disan ti || || 9.
sn11.2:6.4: tam me Sakka varaṃ disan ti || || 11.
sn11.2:8.1: So hi nāma bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo sakam puññaphalaṃ upajīvamāno devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānam issariyādhipaccaṃ rajjam karonto uṭṭhānaviriyassa vaṇṇavādī bhavissati ||
sn11.2:8.2: idha kho taṃ bhikkhave sobhetha yaṃ tumhe evaṃ svākhyāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā uṭṭhaheyyātha ghaṭeyyātha vāyameyyātha appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā ti || || 1.
